subject: Native Windows 11 Arm64 dependency and capability contract
scope_boundary: B02 proves native dependency resolution, installation, lifecycle, and hardware-independent behavior. Physical DGX GPU/model/device performance remains owned by B11, B13, B15, and B16.

hard_rules: An excluded distribution must remain guarded by an explicit Windows Arm64 environment marker in pyproject.toml.
An exclusion is a disclosed capability boundary, not evidence that the package or capability passed.
No x64 wheel, emulated Python process, emulated compiler host, or x64 CMake target can count as Arm64 evidence.
A newly available native artifact requires review and contract amendment before its marker is removed.
